Chanjelin Ward
Master

Burn Option
Master. Put this card on a vampire you control. Actions directed at

I was wondering , because Aching beauty read "put this card on a
toreador you control" and Chanjeling Ward read "Put this card on a
Vampire you control"

Aching Beauty
Master
requires Toreador
cost 2 pool
Master. Put this card on a Toreador. If this Toreador is blocked, the
controller of the blocking minion burns 1 pool (before combat occurs).
